item.title: 銀娛奪IAG Academy IR Awards 4項殊榮 澳門銀河四度蟬聯最佳綜合度假村
item.description:
>
澳門銀河四度蟬聯最佳綜合度假村 銀河娛樂集團(下稱「銀娛」)本週三（9月15日）於菲律賓馬尼拉舉行的「2026 IAG Academy IR Awards」頒獎禮上喜獲4項殊榮，再度成為獲頒最多獎項的澳門綜合度假城營運商，銀娛財務總裁夏維斯代表出席領獎。該評選由亞洲媒體品牌「亞博匯」主辦，經由100位業界專業人士組成評審團，表彰對亞太區綜合旅遊休閒產業具卓越貢獻的企業與人士。 本次評選中，銀娛旗下的「澳門銀河」綜合度假城連續第四年蟬聯「最佳綜合度假村」，並獲「最佳綜合度假村娛樂場」殊榮；澳門銀河嘉佩樂則連續第二年榮獲「最佳綜合度假村酒店」大獎。此外，銀娛亦憑「銀娛體育傳社區計劃」奪得「最佳企業社會責任項目」大獎。 「澳門銀河」匯聚9家豪華酒店品牌、逾120個餐飲品牌、超過200個國際時尚品牌及一系列世界級休閒設施。旗下的銀河國際會議中心及銀河綜藝館自2023年啟用以來，連同其他場地已累計舉辦逾1,300場大型演藝、體育、文娛及會展活動，持續助力澳門建設「世界旅遊休閒中心」。 在社會責任方面，銀娛秉持「取諸社會，用諸社會」的理念，多年來參與及支持過百項體育賽事。本次獲獎的「銀娛體育傳社區計劃」更將國際賽事及運動員資源延伸至社區，透過組織社區觀賽、與澳門特殊奧運會合作推動傷健共融活動，以及舉辦青少年分享會，宣揚體育精神並深耕社區。

item.title: 澳娛美協攜手呈獻光藝相承花燈藝術展
item.description:
>
澳娛美協攜手呈獻光藝相承花燈藝術展 澳娛美協攜手呈獻光藝相承花燈藝術展 為迎接中秋與國慶黃金周，澳娛綜合第五度攜手澳門美術協會，於澳門上葡京綜合度假村呈獻「光藝相承」花燈藝術展。展期由即日起至11月15日免費開放，結合傳統工藝與當代美學，為市民及旅客打造集文化藝術、環球美饌與購物禮遇於一體的節慶盛典。 開幕禮於昨日（16日）舉行，並於展前特設「藝術家分享會」，邀請參展藝術家與逾百位本澳大學生交流，傳承中華傳統文化。澳娛綜合常務董事何超鳳表示，希望藉此發揮「旅遊＋文化」聯動效應，豐富澳門的文化旅遊內涵。四組參展作品包括薛家傑以國際象棋騎士為原型的《弈駿》、安志穎融合布染與印花的《錦卷》、Felipe Wong 結合景泰藍與哥斯達黎加圖騰的《同月》，以及梁倩婷結合古樂與智能感應的《蓮境》。 配合展覽及雙節假期，澳娛綜合特別推出一系列延伸活動與全方位禮遇。度假村將於9月中下旬舉辦花燈工作坊，並於9月24日至10月7日設有賞燈猜謎遊戲，讓賓客贏取豐富禮品。此外，「上葡京花燈寫生日美饌套票」將於10月10日起發售，套票內容包含寫生活動與精選雙人餐。 餐飲與購物方面，澳娛綜合旗下21間餐廳同步呈獻「環球辣味狂歡節」，以10款特色辣椒炮製逾50道辛辣佳餚，並設「尋辣護照」集章抽獎及特色辣醬發售。由9月24日起，賓客於指定商戶累積消費滿額即可換領購物代金券；10月1日起更推出總值超過澳門元20萬的幸運大抽獎，為旅客打造結合藝術、美饌與購物獎賞的黃金周盛宴。

item.title: Ung Si Meng Calligraphy Exhibition Opens at The Parisian Macao
item.description:
>
吳仕明書法展巴黎人開幕，展出澳門著名書法家兼慈善家吳仕明逾80件書法精品。 An exhibition of Chinese calligraphy featuring about 100 works by Macao artist Ung Si Meng opened on September 15 at The Parisian Macao. The exhibition is organized by the Cultural Affairs Bureau of the Macao SAR Government and the Macau Fine Arts Association, co-organized by Sands China Ltd., and supported by the Federation of Macao Cultural and Artistic Circles   As one of the celebratory events marking the 70th anniversary of the Macau Fine Arts Association, the exhibition features over 80 exquisite calligraphic works by renowned local calligrapher and philanthropist Ung Si Meng, showcasing Macao’s cultural heritage and deep patriotic sentiments through the art of brush and ink. Ung expressed his hope that gaming operators will continue to support the local cultural and artistic sector in the future. Ung expressed deep gratitude to Sands China for its strong support of the Macau Fine Arts Association and this exhibition In an interview, Ung expressed deep gratitude to Sands China for its strong support of the Macau Fine Arts Association and this exhibition. He noted that Sands China provides high-quality, large-scale venues for the cultural and arts community to host exhibitions, which greatly aids Macao’s tourism development. This aligns closely with the SAR Government’s policy to diversify tourism, drive economic growth, and foster cultural prosperity. He expressed confidence that a strong economy brings greater social prosperity and stability, reiterating his wish for gaming operators to maintain their backing of local arts and culture.   Wilfred Wong, Executive Vice Chairman of Sands China Ltd., highlighted that the exhibition coincides with the 10th anniversary of The Parisian Macao. He stated that Ung’s noble character and artistic achievements align seamlessly with Sands China’s commitment to cultural heritage and community development. Sands China aims to leverage culture and art to connect the community with tourists, enriching the integrated leisure tourism experience while continuing to contribute to Macao’s development as a “World Centre of Tourism and Leisure.”   Spanning three exhibition halls, the showcase presents over 80 calligraphic pieces, including hanging scrolls, central scrolls, fan surfaces, and couplets. Having dedicated over half a century to the art, Ung’s clerical script integrates the dynamic elegance of the Cao Quan Stele, the grand power of the Zhang Qian Stele, and the quaint simplicity of the Shi Chen Stele.

item.title: Daegu Appeals Court Upholds Verdict in Casino Scam Case and Six Referred to Prosecutors in Jeju Gold Mountain Casino Case
item.description:
>
Daegu Appeals Court Upholds Verdict in Casino Scam Case and Six Referred to Prosecutors in Jeju Gold Mountain Casino Case The conviction of 12 former employees at Daegu Casino in South Korea who attempted to defraud Chinese VIP gamblers out of approximately 4.46 billion KRW (HKD 26.25 million) has been upheld by the appellate court, with all 12 defendants receiving suspended prison sentences. Meanwhile, at the Gold Mountain Casino in Jeju, six individuals, including the casino’s representative and dealers, have been referred to prosecutors for allegedly using marked cards to defraud Chinese tourists of over 100 million KRW (HKD 577,000).   The Daegu incident occurred in 2017, with formal indictments filed in June 2022. The 12 defendants include a former casino CEO, two former top executives, and nine former managers. Court documents reveal that in September 2017, the defendants targeted two Chinese VIP players in baccarat games using prearranged card decks and bottom dealing techniques. Although they attempted to scam approximately 4.46 billion KRW, the plot failed. In July of the same year, the group used similar tactics to defraud a Japanese gambler out of 54.49 million KRW.   Additionally, two defendants were accused of misusing corporate gift cards, originally intended for client hospitality, to pay special allowances to dishonest dealers and distribute staff bonuses across 732 instances, totaling roughly 234 million KRW.   In February 2025, the court of first instance found all 12 defendants guilty. The three top executives received 3-year prison sentences suspended for 5 years, while the remaining defendants received sentences ranging from 1 to 2.5 years, suspended for 2 to 3 years, with some ordered to complete community service. On the 10th of this month, the appellate court largely upheld the original verdict, maintaining suspended sentences for all 12 individuals.   In Jeju, local police announced on September 11 that six individuals, including a hotel casino representative and dealers, were referred to prosecutors. They are accused of using marked cards during blackjack games between June 7 and 8 to scam three Chinese tourists. The corporate entity operating the casino was also referred to prosecutors for negligent supervision.   Allin confirmed with the Jeju government that the venue involved is the Gold Mountain Casino. Located inside The Shilla Jeju, the property was formerly known as Megaluck Casino before local firm Geumsan Co Ltd took over operations in 2024.   Authorities began investigating the property in June after routine regulatory monitoring revealed an abnormal single day spike in gaming revenue. Furthermore, blackjack revenue significantly surpassed baccarat, which typically dominates local casinos, raising suspicions of irregular game behavior. Authorities inspected the playing cards and CCTV footage before handing the case over to the police.   Police investigations revealed that the suspects used marked cards featuring subtle indicators on the back or edges to identify specific cards during blackjack games, generating illicit proceeds exceeding 100 million KRW. The Jeju government plans to issue administrative sanctions against Gold Mountain Casino upon receiving the final police investigation results.

item.title: 吳仕明書法展巴黎人開幕 盼博企繼續支持澳門文化藝術事業
item.description:
>
吳仕明書法展巴黎人開幕，展出澳門著名書法家兼慈善家吳仕明逾80件書法精品。 由澳門文化局與澳門美術協會主辦、金沙中國協辦、澳門文化界聯合總會支持的「家國情懷：吳仕明書法作品展」，於本周二(15日)在澳門巴黎人三樓展廳舉行開幕儀式。作為澳門美術協會成立70年系列慶祝活動之一，展覽展出澳門著名書法家兼慈善家吳仕明逾80件書法精品，以筆墨藝術展現澳門文化底蘊與深厚的家國情懷。吳仕明期望博企未來能繼續支持澳門文化藝術事業。 吳仕明接受訪問時表示，非常感謝金沙中國對澳門美術協會及今次展覽的大力支持。他指金沙中國提供優質大型場地供文化藝術界舉辦展覽，對推動澳門旅遊發展很有幫助，亦非常配合澳門政府促進旅遊業多元化、帶動經濟發展與文化興盛的方針。他相信經濟發展好，社會就會更加繁榮穩定，並期望博企未來能繼續支持澳門文化藝術事業。 金沙中國行政副主席王英偉指出，展覽適逢澳門巴黎人開業10周年，吳仕明德藝雙馨的精神與金沙中國推動文化傳承及社區發展的理念高度契合。金沙中國希望藉由文化藝術連結社區與旅客，豐富綜合旅遊休閒體驗，持續為澳門建設世界旅遊休閒中心貢獻力量。 展覽分佈於3個展廳，共展出逾80件書法作品，涵蓋立軸、中堂、扇面及對聯等形式。吳仕明深耕書藝半世紀，隸書融匯《曹全碑》之靈動飄逸、《張遷碑》之雄渾大氣與《史晨碑》之古樸渾厚。展出內容除國家領導人金句、山河詠懷與古詩詞外，亦包含記錄其於陝南捐建「慈安便民橋」的扶貧懷思作品，將人生體悟與家國情懷融入金石筆墨中。

item.title: 大邱娛樂場12員工詐騙中國VIP賭客案 法院二審維持原判緩刑
item.description:
>
大邱娛樂場12名前員工涉詐案二審維持原判緩刑裁決。 南韓兩宗涉及賭場內部人員涉嫌操控賭局的案件近日有新進展。大邱娛樂場(Daegu Casino)12名前員工涉及向中國VIP賭客詐騙約44.6億韓圜(約2,540萬港元)未遂，以及其他詐騙和挪用公款案，法院近日作出二審判決，12名被告均獲判緩刑。另一方面，濟州金山娛樂場(Gold Mountain Casino)涉嫌使用「記號牌」詐騙中國賭客逾1億韓圜(約57萬港元)，包括賭場代表及荷官在內6人已被移送檢方。 大邱案發生於2017年，案件於2022年6月提出起訴。12名涉案人士包括賭場前行政總裁、兩名前高層及9名前管理人員。據法院資料，涉案人士被指於2017年9月針對兩名中國籍VIP賭客，利用預先排列牌序的撲克牌及「抽底牌」等手法操控百家樂賭局，企圖騙取約44.6億韓圜，但最終未能成功。同年7月，他們被指以相同手法從一名日本賭客騙取約5,449萬韓圜(約31萬港元)。 另外，兩名被告被控將原本只限用於招待賭場客戶的公司禮品卡，擅自用於向「黑荷官」支付特別津貼及向員工發放獎勵等合共732次，涉及約2.34億韓圜(約133萬港元)。 一審法院2025年2月裁定12人有罪，其中3名高層各被判有期徒刑3年、緩刑5年，其餘被告分別被判有期徒刑1年至2年6個月、緩刑2年至3年，部分被告另須完成社會服務。法院本月10日進行二審大致維持原判，12名被告均繼續獲判緩刑。 至於濟州方面，當地警方本月11日表示，已將一間酒店賭場的代表、荷官等6名相關人士移送檢方，涉嫌今年6月7至8日利用「記號牌」操控21點賭局，詐騙3名中國旅客；涉案賭場法人亦因涉嫌疏於監督被移送檢方。 Allin向濟州政府確認，涉事場館為濟州金山娛樂場。該場館位於濟州新羅酒店，前身為Megaluck Casino，2024年由本地公司Geumsan Co Ltd接手營運。 案件早於今年6月已受到當局調查。濟州政府在日常監管期間發現金山娛樂場單日博彩收入異常增加，而且21點收入明顯高於當地賭場通常佔主導地位的百家樂，因而懷疑賭局存在異常。當局其後檢查相關撲克牌及閉路電視片段揭發案件，交由警方調查。 警方最新調查指，涉案人士涉嫌使用牌背或邊緣帶有細微標記、可用以辨認特定牌面的「記號牌」進行21點賭局，涉案犯罪收益逾1億韓圜。 濟州政府計劃在收到調查結果後對金山娛樂場作出行政處分。
